components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; background: hsl(220 20% 97%); } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid hsl(220 16% 90%); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: hsl(222 30% 14%); font: 600 14px Anuphan, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: hsl(220 12% 80%); } .ds-chip-on { background: hsl(47 86% 86%); border-color: transparent; } .ds-swatch { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: hsl(203 72% 90%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px hsl(203 40% 70%); }

components.css: .ds-board { background: hsl(220 20% 97%); padding: 24px; } .ds-notice { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 180px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; color: hsl(222 30% 14%); border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; font-family: Anuphan, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px hsl(220 16% 90%), 0 1px 2px rgb(15 25 50 / .05); transition: translate .2s ease-out, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-notice:hover { translate: 0 -2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px hsl(220 16% 90%), 0 12px 28px -12px rgb(15 25 50 / .28); } .ds-notice-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: hsl(203 72% 90%); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-dot { display: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-right: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: hsl(203 66% 64%); vertical-align: middle; } .ds-notice-photo { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4/3; background: hsl(203 72% 90% / .6); } .ds-stamp { position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: 8px; padding: 1px 8px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; color: hsl(352 62% 46%); background: rgb(255 255 255 / .88); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; } .ds-notice-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 12px; } .ds-notice-body small { color: hsl(222 10% 36%); font-size: 13px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-board { background: hsl(0 0% 5%); } .ds-notice { background: hsl(220 6% 10%); color: hsl(0 0% 94%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px hsl(220 6% 18%); } .ds-notice-head { background: hsl(220 6% 10%); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 hsl(220 6% 18%); } .ds-dot { display: inline-block; } .ds-notice-photo { background: hsl(220 6% 7%); } .ds-stamp { color: hsl(352 80% 70%); background: hsl(220 6% 10% / .88); } .ds-notice-body small { color: hsl(220 5% 72%); } }

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: Status as an upright ink stamp: round red waiting, square blue verified, struck grey returned. Shape and word carry the status, never colour alone.
components.html: รอเจ้าของยืนยันแล้ว รอรับคืนแล้ว
components.css: .ds-stamps { display: flex; gap: 20px; padding: 20px; background: #fff; font-family: Anuphan, sans-serif; } .ds-st { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 10px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; animation: ds-press .42s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } .ds-st-wait { color: hsl(352 62% 46%); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-st-ok { color: hsl(222 62% 40%); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-st-done { color: hsl(222 8% 46%); border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: line-through 2px; } @keyframes ds-press { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.6); filter: blur(3px); } 60% { opacity: 1; filter: none; } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }

narrative.overview:
The app is a notice board stripped to its essentials. The light theme is a pale grey board with a white header and white cards; each found item is a card whose header carries a soft category tint, and its status is an ink stamp. The dark theme goes further toward white-minimal: a near-black board, dark grey cards, card headers in the card's own colour with a small category dot, and white primary buttons. Navigation and controls stay standard web controls.

The surface is an Operate surface: an anxious owner searching on a phone, a finder logging an item, a guard at the booth. Expression never hides the task, and photos of found items are the most colourful thing on screen.
keyCharacteristics: Light theme: pale grey board, white header with a hairline rule, white cards, pastel category headers, navy primary buttons.
Dark theme: near-black board, dark grey cards, category shown as a dot in a plain header, white primary buttons.
Hairline edges (a 1px ring inside the shadow) instead of heavy drop shadows; no pins, no scalloped trim, no tilted elements.
Status stamps: round red = waiting for owner, square blue = verified, struck grey = returned.
Itim marker voice for page titles only; Anuphan for everything else.

rules.name: The Route Stock Rule
rules.body: Each top-level route owns one category hue: found items yellow, report lost pink, report found mint, guard panel sky, account sand. The active nav item wears it, and page titles carry it as a short bar above the heading.

rules.name: The Dark Header Rule
rules.body: In dark theme any element with `.notice-head` drops its tint and shows its `.notice-dot` instead; `.stock-wash` placeholders fall back to the plain field colour. These overrides live unlayered at the end of `styles.css`.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Itim is handwriting on the board: page titles, item titles, dialog titles. Never for body, labels, buttons, or numbers.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every shadow token starts with a 1px `line` ring, so cards get an edge without a border that shifts layout. Cards nested inside a sheet get no shadow; separate them with rules.

dos: **Do** keep reading surfaces on paper and text on the board in on-felt tokens.
**Do** let item photos be the loudest colour on screen; categories stay soft.
**Do** carry status with stamp shape and word, never colour alone.
**Do** keep motion to the stamp press, the dialog sheet rising, and hover lifts.
donts: **Don't** use gradients, glass, glow shadows, or gradient text.
**Don't** bring back pins, scalloped trim, or tilted cards and titles.
**Don't** nest a shadowed card inside a sheet; separate with rules instead.
**Don't** use heavy drop shadows; edges come from the hairline ring.
